about.title: About
about.bio:
Hey there, Matei here.

Passionate about music and visuals, I've been around them all my life. I've worn a lot of hats: graphic designer for a music venue for 5+ years, a musician playing festivals and venues across France, and now a designer at a music startup. A couple of years ago I started bringing a camera along too, to capture moments of places and people.

Everything not saved will be lost.
